By
Nia Dumas
Orchestra Noir was founded in 2016 by music director Jason Ikeem Rodgers. The all-Black Atlanta-based orchestra performs classic hits spanning the genres of jazz, blues and R&B.
Andre Calder
hide caption
toggle caption i
Andre Calder
Ashley Branch, Orchestra Noir's operations manager, hurriedly completes her final tasks before curtain call at the Warner Theater in Washington, D.C. It is two hours before the ensemble's Saturday night concert and her main goal is simple: plan to deal with whatever she didn't plan for.
The D.C. show comes partway through the ensemble's 20-city The Culture 2000s tour, which has taken the group to cities like Jacksonville and Philadelphia.
Founded in 2016 by music director Jason Ikeem Rodgers, the all-Black Atlanta-based orchestra performs classic hits spanning the genres of jazz, blues and R&B. Branch has been with Orchestra Noir for about two years, hired to bring relief to Keisha Rodgers, the orchestra's original operations manager, who now serves as president of operations. On show nights, it's Branch who is directing the final details on show prep.

item.title: Texas execution took over an hour as staff struggled to find vein; Reinaldo Dennes moaned about pain
item.description:

Texas execution took over an hour as staff struggled to find vein; Reinaldo Dennes moaned about pain
November 20, 20267:24 AM ET
By
The Associated Press
This photo combination shows Reinaldo Dennes, left, on April 14, 2026 and Thomas Mitchell Overton.
Texas Department of Criminal Justice/AP
hide caption
toggle caption i
Texas Department of Criminal Justice/AP
HUNTSVILLE, Texas — Texas executed Reinaldo Dennes on Thursday in a procedure that took over an hour, as prison staffers struggled to find a suitable vein for the two intravenous needles carrying the lethal dose of the sedative pentobarbital.
And once it began, he moaned repeatedly about pain, groaned several times and asked God to take him away from the pain. A prison spokesperson said all procedures were followed appropriately and suggested that Dennes might have exaggerated or faked the pain.
The execution followed renewed scrutiny of capital punishment in the U.S. in the aftermath of Tennessee's failed execution in September of Christa Pike, who survived two doses of pentobarbital that her lawyers say probably did not enter her bloodstream correctly and instead pooled in her arms, leaving them burned and blistered.

item.title: New York City unveils a bold plan to move its jails off Rikers Island
item.description:
Law
New York City unveils a bold plan to move its jails off Rikers Island
November 20, 20265:00 AM ET
Meg Anderson
New York City officials have created a road map for how they'll close the jail complex on Rikers Island and move to smaller facilities within the boroughs. Mayor Zohran Mamdani closed the North Infirmary Command building, seen here, on Rikers earlier this year.
Nicky Quamina-Woo/NPR
hide caption
toggle caption i
Nicky Quamina-Woo/NPR
New York City officials on Friday unveiled their plan to close the troubled jail complex on Rikers Island, the city's main pre-trial detention center, which has been plagued with reports of abuse and neglect for decades.
"It is long past time to close what's been a moral stain on our city," Mayor Zohran Mamdani told NPR. "We cannot simply accept the old approaches to public safety just because they've always been done that way."
Rikers, which sits on a former garbage dump in the East River, has long been infamous for its dismal conditions – including crumbling infrastructure. Inmates have accused guards of excessive force, sexual assault and high rates of violence in multiple lawsuits.
